text: abc company leave policy employees receive 20 annual leave days. employees can work remotely 3 days every week. managers must approve leave requests.

1. general all business travel requires prior written approval from your reporting manager. 2. expense submission submit all travel claims via the company expense portal within 7 days of the trip. 3. reimbursement processing all valid claims will be processed within 15 days of submission. 4. hotel booking all hotel reservations should be made through the corporate travel portal. 5. accommodation limits employees must book standard midrange business hotels within city caps. 6. incidentals

business hotels within city caps. 6. incidentals personal charges like inroom movies minibar or laundry are not reimbursable. 7. meal allowance employees are provided a maximum daily per diem based on the destination. 8. meal claims meals must be documented the per diem allowance cannot be rolled over to the next day. 9. alcohol alcoholic beverages are considered nonreimbursable personal expenses. 10. taxi claims use the most costeffective ground transport shared ridesharing services are

ground transport shared ridesharing services are encouraged. 11. airport transfers taxi claims are permitted for travel to and from the airport and client offices. 12. taxi receipts original or digital receipts are mandatory for all taxi claims exceeding the local limit. 13. nonreimbursable fines for parking traffic violations or missed flights caused by personal negligence. 14. advances employees may request a travel advance for anticipated outofpocket expenses. 15. currency foreign travel

outofpocket expenses. 15. currency foreign travel expenses must be claimed in the local currency or converted using bank receipts. 16. companions the company will not reimburse any travel or meal expenses for nonemployee companions. 17. entertainment preapproved client entertainment meals require the names of all attendees on the receipt. 18. lost receipts expenses over 10 missing a proper receipt will not be reimbursed without a formal justification. 19. safety in case of emergencies employees
19. safety in case of emergencies employees must immediately contact hr and their line manager. 20. policy agreement by submitting a claim employees confirm all expenses comply with this policy.
